
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ifmeme/p/19362797" title="发布于 2025-12-17 16:12">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Apipost分支功能：为API开发打造专属的成本控制与协作流程</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>在快速迭代的产品开发中，API 的变更管理常成为团队协作的“黑洞”：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>新功能开发的接口还没测试完，就被其他人同步到测试环境的改动“覆盖”了；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>紧急修复线上Bug时，担心影响正在进行的迭代；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>多人同时修改同一项目下的接口，合并时冲突频发，回退困难……</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span>这些看似琐碎的问题，本质上都是因为缺乏一套安全的API版本管理与协作机制。Apipost的 API分支功能，恰恰解决了这些问题，它将代码版本控制中成熟的分支理念，无缝应用到API开发测试的全流程中。</span></p>
<p><strong>一、分支功能的需求及应用场景</strong></p>
<p><span><span>场景<span><span>1<span><span>：需保证<span><span>主分支稳定的情况下进行迭代开发</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><strong><span><span>如果主分支（线上接口）的稳定不能保证，很容易造成功能还没开发完，测试还没开始，新字段直接覆盖到主分支，导致产品叫停，开发被迫紧急回滚。</span></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span>本质：没有接口级的版本隔离。</span></strong></p>
<h3><strong><span><span>场景 2：多个迭代</span></span></strong><strong><span><span>并行</span></span></strong><strong><span><span>开发，接口互相覆盖、冲突频发</span></span></strong></h3>
<p><strong><span><span>A 业务线做活动改了用户接口，B 业务线做会员也改了，最后两边互相覆盖，冲突解决不完，谁都不敢合并。</span></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span>本质：<span>没有</span></span></strong><strong><span><span>并行</span></span></strong><strong><span><span>开发隔离机制，也没有冲突解决体系。</span></span></strong></p>
<h3><strong><span><span>场景 3：新人误操作，直接修改“线上接口”</span></span></strong></h3>
<p><strong><span><span>新人在主分支调试接口，顺手改了参数。 &nbsp;结果线上服务异常、客户投诉、团队找 BUG 找到怀疑人生。</span></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span>本质：<span><span>没有主分支保护与审批流程。</span></span></span></strong></p>
<h3><strong><span><span>场景 4：想尝试重构、试验新方案，却不敢动</span></span></strong></h3>
<p><strong><span><span>重构接口风险太大，万一改坏了影响太多模块，只能拖、只能忍</span></span></strong><span><span>。</span></span></p>
<p><strong><span>本质：<span><span>缺乏可丢弃的“安全实验空间”。</span></span></span></strong></p>
<h3><strong><span><span>场景 5：线上出现 Bug，需要紧急修，但当前版本迭代不能停</span></span></strong></h3>
<p><strong><span><span>修 Bug 必须动接口，但当前分支正在进行大迭代，贸然改动会影响整体测试节奏。</span></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span>本质：<span>缺乏补丁分支机制。</span></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span><span>场景6：外包团队协<span><span>作开发，<strong><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>需要开放接口权限，但必须确保主项目安全</span></span></span></strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;margin: 0px 16px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-align: justify;text-indent: 0em;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></span></span></span></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;margin: 0px !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>外包团队协作开发，无法在保障核心数据与接口安全的前提下实现可控的协作开发。</span></span></strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;table&quot;,{&quot;interlaced&quot;:null,&quot;align&quot;:null,&quot;class&quot;:null,&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 0px 0px 10px;padding: 1em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>本质：缺乏针对外部协作的<strong><span>项目级权限隔离机制</span></strong><span>。</span></span></span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span><span>……</span></span></strong></p>
<p><span><span>以上这些场景痛点，都是传统 API 文档/管理工具无法解决的，而&nbsp;<strong><span><span>Apipost 分支功能，就是专为此类场景而构建。</span></span></strong></span></span></p>
<p><strong>二、Apipost分支功能的具体使用</strong></p>
<p><span><span>1、创建独立分支：每个迭代都有自己的“开发空间” &nbsp;</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>每个成员可创建自己的迭代分支</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span>创建者默认成为分支管理员</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span>支持为分支命名、<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []">填写分支说明，清晰区分不同开发目标。</span></span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<h2><img alt="1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2660627/202512/2660627-20251217160256383-1481519185.png" class="lazyload"></h2>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 16px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>2、按需拉取主分支数据</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>迭代分支创建完成后，需&nbsp;<strong><span><span>选择性导入主分支数据</span></span></strong><span><span>&nbsp;（接口、模型、用例）作为开发基线，无需全量同步，便于控制变更范围。</span></span></span></span></p>

<span data-pm-slice="2 5 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-style&quot;:&quot;margin-bottom: 5px; outline: 0px; letter-spacing: 0.544px; [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-style&quot;:&quot;margin-bottom: 5px; outline: 0px; letter-spacing: 0.544px; background-color: rgb(255, <p><img alt="3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2660627/202512/2660627-20251217160348144-124350021.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2><strong><span><span>3、完整冲突解决体系：可视化、片段级选择</span></span></strong></h2>
<p><span><span>当检测到主分支与当前分支存在差异时，系统会智能标记“冲突”，并提供可视化对比界面，手动决策是否保留、替换或合并，极大提升操作的可控性和透明度。</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>若冲突数据项显示 “冲突” 标记；</span></span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>点击冲突标记进入对比视图：</span></span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>选择解决方案</span></span><img alt="4" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2660627/202512/2660627-20251217160419342-97146463.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="冲突" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2660627/202512/2660627-20251217160521508-297917330.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span><span>所有操作可预览，结果可回溯。</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;heading&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;h2&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;class&quot;:&quot;heading-2&quot;,&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 16px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;,&quot;level&quot;:2},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:null},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>4、合并到主分支：可控、可审、可回溯</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>完成迭代分支开发测试后，通过本流程将已验证数据 安全同步至主分支 ，实现版本迭代闭环：</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>进入迭代分支工作区 点击操作栏 合并到主分支“按钮”<img alt="7" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2660627/202512/2660627-20251217160624383-231517471.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></p>
</li>

</ul>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>选择性合并资源（仅勾选实际需要发布的资源，避免合并未验证内容）<img alt="8" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2660627/202512/2660627-20251217160656041-311306784.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span><span>配置接口状态</span></span></p>

</li>

</ul>

<span data-pm-slice="2 5 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-style&quot;:&quot;margin-bottom: 5px; outline: 0px; letter-spacing: 0.544px; <p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 8px; padding: 0px; <p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 8px; padding: 0px; <h2><img alt="加审批" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2660627/202512/2660627-20251217160839461-939475977.png" class="lazyload"></h2>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 8px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>6、分支成员管理：权限独立、可见性隔离</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>系统可动态配置分支成员权限（如只读、读写、分支管理员等），与主分支权限体系解耦，让分支成为真正独立的空间。</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>每个分支都有独立成员列表</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span>支持只读/读写/管理员</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span>普通成员默认只能看到加入的分支</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span>群组管理员不可移除</span></p>

</li>

</ul>

<span data-pm-slice="2 5 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-style&quot;:&quot;margin-bottom: 5px; outline: 0px; letter-spacing: 0.544px; data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2660627/202512/2660627-20251217160913527-1015915434.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></span>
<p><span><span>三、最佳实践与使用建议</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="2 1 []"><span><span>为了让分支体系更高效，建议团队遵循以下规则：</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 8px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>1、<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 16px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>分支一定要短平快，用完就归档</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 16px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>避免出现十几个“僵尸分支”；</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 8px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>2、每次合并前必须对比差异</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 16px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>尤其是模型变化和接口状态；</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 8px; padding: 0px; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>分支请务必设为受保护</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 16px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>所有生产环境的风险控制，都从这里开始；</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 8px; padding: 0px; <p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 16px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>按需导入可减少冲突，也更能控制迭代范围。</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px 16px 16px; padding: 0px; outline: 0px; max-width: 100%; clear: both; min-height: 1em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 17px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75em; visibility: visible; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>其他常见问题：</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>Q1<span><span>、A<span><span>pipost<span><span>的分支功能是免费的吗？</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>是的<span><span>，<span><span>免费。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>Q2<span><span>、<span><span>Apipost<span><span>的分支功能支持哪些协议？</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>在<span><span>Apipost<span><span>中，<span><span>HTTP<span><span>、<span><span>SSE<span><span>、<span><span>GraphQL<span><span>、<span><span>WebSocket<span><span>、<span><span>Socket.IO<span><span>、<span><span>TCP<span><span>等类型的接口都支持分支功能；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>Q3<span><span>、<span><span>Apipost<span><span>分支功能可以免费使用几个分支</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>Apipost<span><span>支持多个分支的使用。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>四、总结</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>API 是软件资产，而Apipost的分支机制，是对 API 的专业级版本管理方式。一句话：</span></span></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><span><span>它让&nbsp;</span></span></strong><strong><span><span>API</span></span></strong><strong><span><span>&nbsp;管理和协作真正进入“工程化、可控、安全、协作高效”的新阶段。</span></span></strong></p>

</blockquote>
<p><span><span>如果你的团队正面临接口改动频繁、协作混乱、版本管理风险大等问题，Apipost 分支功能将会是在更新迭代的团队协作中最值得立即启用的能力之一。</span></span></p>
